orderBasis: Development sequence inferred from model features and project records; not verified creation dates.

items.title: First spatial study
items.description: An early shared scene for indoor discovery and outdoor movement.
items.descriptionZh: 将室内探索与户外移动放进同一个空间原型。

items.title: A little world by the bay
items.description: A visual study of the waterfront, family spectatorship and digital gulls.
items.descriptionZh: 探索海湾氛围、家长观察位置与地面海鸥的视觉关系。

items.title: FishPal comes to life
items.description: A standalone miniature exploring the device, discovery and two-child sharing.
items.descriptionZh: 独立微缩模型，探索设备、发现过程与双人分享。

items.title: Following a digital shadow
items.description: A movement study with responsive shadows, proximity and the early chips effect.
items.descriptionZh: 研究海鸥影子、移动与靠近反馈，保留早期薯条效果。

items.title: Discovery in the real market
items.description: A photo-informed retail corner connecting FishPal to stalls and NFC points.
items.descriptionZh: 参考场地照片，把 FishPal 与摊位及 NFC 点位结合。

items.title: Play along the waterfront
items.description: A site-specific model of the canopy, dining promenade and ground interaction.
items.descriptionZh: 重建屋顶、用餐步道与地面互动之间的空间关系。

items.title: Bringing the experiences together
items.description: A unified study with guided scenes, individual and group modes, and device detail.
items.descriptionZh: 整合分步场景、单人与多人模式，以及设备细节。

items.title: A more detailed shared experience
items.description: A richer integrated model with pixel decoration, hand icons and interactive device controls.
items.descriptionZh: 进一步加入像素装饰、手形提示和可交互的设备按钮。
